scope: 16 trap families, 32 L2 directions and 32 L3 maturity upgrades; complete per-node review with static map examples

shared_contract.enemy_only: Only manifested legal hostile targets trigger; humans, player, paper guards and disguised visitors do not trigger, pay charges or reveal identity.

placement.effective_field: declared circle intersect walkable floor, exclude solid fixtures and walls, then apply actual height and LOS

upgrade.path: L1 -> L2 A or B -> the chosen L3 maturity upgrade
upgrade.exception: R12 uses actual footprint cells: L2 +6 coin/+1 spirit per cell; L3 +8 coin/+2 spirit per cell.

charge_and_repair.recharge_coin_per_charge: max(1, ceil(0.30 * actual L1 footprint build coin / L1 initial charge capacity))
charge_and_repair.refundable_hardware_principal: charged trap: 0.7 * actual paid L1 footprint coin + paid upgrades; no-charge R12: paid L1 footprint coin + paid upgrades; exclude previous services and reselection fees

shared_contract.effect_lifetime: Maintained fields stop when source is disabled or destroyed; already applied finite states keep their absolute deadlines; permanent poison lasts until health-pool terminal and conserves mass across fission.
shared_contract.status_authority: All status thresholds, durations, stacking, immunity, damage modifiers and electric reactions come from the shared TD04 combat contract; trap parameters only specify application amounts and explicit fields.

provisional_poison_unit.fission: partition total poison mass, do not copy

movement_toll.continuous_motion: sweep actual traversed cells and legal height, including displacement; one receipt per health pool per zone period
movement_toll.phase_motion: true teleport, shadow jump and mirror transit audit all positive-length intermediate cells plus the actual origin and destination half-open cells, deduplicated; no solid fixture cell is a payable zone
movement_toll.overlap: One shared receipt per health pool/zone/family. Evaluate every eligible candidate packet against this target current defense, source penetration and vulnerability, select highest final payable damage; stable source_id breaks ties. Never select by raw amount across channels.
movement_toll.receipt_survives: source move, upgrade, power toggling and save/load
movement_toll.continuous_run: Accumulate actually charged new-zone receipts across physics/render frames; actual stop or discontinuous phase movement ends run. Stationary periodic ticks are not crossings.
movement_toll.crossing_bonus_receipt: Shared by pool and bonus family for 2 seconds; source switch, frame boundary or source move cannot reset.
movement_toll.independent_features: An eligible source independent status pulse, stationary reward or explicitly permitted movement reward retains its own event and cooldown contract even when its base zone packet loses arbitration; this does not add another base zone packet.
movement_toll.phase_refresh: one phase_event_id/health_pool/cell receipt bypasses that cell prior cooldown once, charges once, then sets deadline to arrival_world_time + 2 seconds
movement_toll.phase_snapshot_time: after legal arrival and explicit R09 paid activation, before the whole phase damage batch; fields legally armed before this snapshot may participate
movement_toll.same_cell_phase: nonzero phase segment wholly inside one valid cell pays that cell once; cancelled or zero-displacement movement pays no phase toll
movement_toll.R09_arming_exception: a valid committed phase audit intersecting at least one armed R09 cell may atomically spend one trap charge to start the 8-second field before settling that same phase; at most one charge per trap/phase_event_id
movement_toll.crossing_bonus_phase: a phase may satisfy R09.A by at least two distinct billed cells in this trap footprint; share its existing 2-second bonus receipt, do not reset it with phase
movement_toll.phase_cell_set: positive-length intermediate segment cells UNION half-open origin cell UNION half-open destination cell, deduplicated; intermediate corner-only touches excluded

electric_contact.count_dedup: unique health_pool_id and unique powered appliance_id; no body-part or socket duplication
electric_contact.contact_domain: Geometric union of the original appliance contact domain and all currently valid linked relay domains for the same appliance_id.
electric_contact.reentry_condition: Actually exit the entire union then re-enter; movement from original domain into relay domain while continuously inside the union is not re-entry.
movement_event_order: apply explicit R16 entry charge once
apply eligible appliance contact electric damage
optional one-hop bounce and one feedback charge
electric_contact.network_search: traverse entire reachable component of charged hostile health pools and real powered appliance nodes; each damaged pool uses its own local N+E formula

shared_contract.secondary_effects: Normal secondary effects have at most one child generation and cannot produce normal on-hit stacks. Electricity is an explicit exception: every positive electric-damage packet adds its declared charge, including contact, the one ordinary bounce, and overload feedback. Overload consumes 5 charge and returns min(1,2/m) to each of m damaged pools, total at most 2; it can enqueue later overloads but never recursively repeats a contact movement event.
shared_contract.partial_height_support: Ordinary traps are ground-only; any low/high-air support is explicitly listed per trap/upgrade. Freeze fixes actual position but does not change height.

graybox_counterexamples: 连续地面跨三新区得三份；同一2秒内走回旧区不重复。真瞬移/影跃/镜穿同样沿线三有效格得三份，并把这三格冷却设为本次抵达+2秒。
同一phase_event_id重放不得再扣R09充能、再发伤害或再次重置截止。
真转场跨墙和货架时只统计已有有效地面计伤格；固体自身不生成格，墙后已有合法区仍可纳入相位审计。
相位审计中段只喂分区伤与明确的过路奖励，不触发胶带、夹具、电器真实经过或驻留火场。
圆形小场最小半径1；画出被货架裁掉的部分，不能把货架中心的小圈当作实际可进入火区。
R13.B3驻留2.25秒只得9原始场伤；多显示帧不额外补跳。
R16.B在同次真正进入轨和设备原生域时得2直接电荷+1接触反馈，两次t0/t4可达6；没有真实再进入则不能。
过载图可跨多跳真实节点覆盖远端敌；同一AP多槽多轨只计一个节点，铜轨不延长边距。
过载电伤继续加层，但每消耗5最多回填总2，关开电器不会创造无限外源。
夜间更替保留等级、位置、剩余充能和耐久；第七夜结算后本周防御资产清空，长期知识保留。
部位共池只算一个电网单位；真正独立分裂按总状态质量与截止分配，不复制。
F60的观察镜没有镜穿；R06只在已登记镜穿波次或专门测试体开放。
